intended_object: An auxiliary S-linear map (∀ i, N ⊗[R] M i) → N ⊗[R] (∀ i, M i). Its docstring marks it "(Implementation)": it is the inverse map used to build the equivalence `TensorProduct.piRight`.
explanation: The docstring explicitly calls this an implementation detail: it is the inverse direction used to construct the linear equivalence `TensorProduct.piRight`. The construction is the expected one. Using `lsum`, it sums over i the maps id ⊗ single_i, so the definition is correct. Still, it is a helper construction, not a standalone mathematical notion. The mathematical content is the isomorphism N ⊗ (Π M_i) ≅ Π (N ⊗ M_i) for finite ι, and Mathlib packages that as `TensorProduct.piRight`.
